name: Add To Cart AI
author: Add To Cart AI

sections.description:
Add To Cart AI brings conversational and visual shopping to your WooCommerce store. Instead of browsing through categories and filters, your customers can simply describe what they want, paste a shopping list, or upload a product photo — and the AI assistant finds matching products and adds them to the cart.

Three Ways to Shop

  • Chat — Customers type natural requests like “I need ingredients for tacos” and the assistant builds their cart.
  • Lists — Shoppers paste any shopping list and the AI matches items from your catalog instantly.
  • Photos — Customers upload a reference image and the assistant finds similar products in your store.

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin on your WooCommerce store
  2. Create a free account at addtocart.ai and get your API key
  3. Enter your API key in the plugin settings
  4. The shopping assistant appears on your storefront, ready to help customers

Privacy-First Design

Add To Cart AI is built with privacy in mind. The service provides controls to help store owners support their GDPR and CCPA compliance efforts, including options for data deletion requests and minimal data retention. Store owners remain responsible for their own compliance obligations.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • An Add To Cart AI account (free trial available)

External services

This plugin relies on the following external services to function:

  • Add To Cart AI API (https://api.addtocart.ai)

    • Used for: Search processing, product matching, and cart analysis.
    • Data Sent: Product data (during sync), search queries, and cart contents.
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • Add To Cart AI Widget (https://widget.addtocart.ai)

    • Used for: Hosting the chat interface JavaScript.
    • Data Sent: User interactions within the chat widget.
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the add-to-cart-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Add To Cart AI to configure the plugin.
  4. Create an account at addtocart.ai if you haven’t already.
  5. Copy your API key from the Add To Cart AI dashboard and paste it into the plugin settings.
  6. Save your settings — the assistant will appear on your store.
sections.faq:
What is Add To Cart AI?

Add To Cart AI is an AI shopping assistant that helps your WooCommerce customers find and add products to their cart through conversation, shopping lists, or product photos.

Do I need an account to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin connects to the Add To Cart AI service, which requires an account. You can sign up for a free trial at addtocart.ai.

Which e-commerce platforms are supported?

Currently, Add To Cart AI supports WooCommerce. Support for additional platforms is planned.

Is the assistant customizable?

Yes. You can toggle the widget on or off per page, change the display language, and adjust the appearance to match your store’s design.

How does Add To Cart AI handle customer data?

The service is designed with privacy in mind and provides controls to help merchants meet GDPR and CCPA requirements, including data deletion and minimal data retention options. Merchants remain responsible for their own compliance.

Where can I get support?

Visit addtocart.ai/contact or email support for assistance.
